name: Buffalo milk
description: The default milk across much of South Asia — thicker and far richer than cow's.

tcm.note: Not a staple of the Chinese record; read alongside cow's milk.

ayurveda.note: Mahisha dugdha is classically shita and guru, and specifically named as sleep-inducing.

unani.note: Thanda and heavy — more so than cow's milk, which is why it is cut with water for chai.

histamine.note: Fresh milk, low — same as cow's.

nutrition.highlight: nearly twice the fat of cow's milk

guna.note: Fresh dairy is sattvic; the reading changes once it sours or ages.
